title: QCLI-509's completed record opens with superseded test counts and carries no unresolvedAtCompletion for its unchecked AC2
description:
Filed from the QCLI-509 confirmatory review (opum-workflow:review-assignment, run job-1rbehfg, attempt 3, recorded seq 24730, verdict approve at 26809484; PR #624 merged as 01cd9828). Both findings are in the completed QCLI-509 record, not in the gate or the probe; the review judged them non-blocking and land proceeded on that basis.

(1) Superseded test counts. QCLI-509 finalSummary opens with "test/qcli509-release-binary-probe.test.ts (7)" and "bun run test 1215 pass, 0 fail", then states "1216 pass", and closes with a correction line stating 9 tests and 1217 pass which says it supersedes both earlier counts. Only the closing figures are current; the reviewer measured 9 tests passing and 1217 pass / 0 fail across 138 files at 26809484. This is the second time this field has carried stale counts: round-2 F1 was the same class, and the round-3 fix appended a correction rather than correcting the opening.

(2) Missing unresolvedAtCompletion. QCLI-509 is Done with acceptance criterion index 1 (AC2, the committed 0.14.0 binary answering the probes) unchecked, but the completed record carries no persisted unresolvedAtCompletion field, so quest task list --unresolved-at-completion does not surface it. Measured: the key is absent rather than null, and 15 other completed records carry it, so the absence is meaningful. The deferral itself is stated in the record notes (verified at the 0.14.0 rebuild under QCLI-499) and enforced by the gate at that rebuild, so this hides the record only from a tracker sweep, not from a reader who opens it.

Scope: tracker record text only. No code, gate or workflow change is expected.

acceptanceCriteria.text: QCLI-509 finalSummary carries exactly one set of test figures, taken from a fresh run at fix time, with no superseded count left in the field
QCLI-509 carries a persisted unresolvedAtCompletion naming the unchecked AC2 and its 0.14.0-rebuild dependency, and quest task list --unresolved-at-completion lists QCLI-509
quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude and lore check both exit 0 after the record edit

plan: 1. Fresh figures at dev tip 5e7f5aed (full suite and the probe suite).
2. Replace the QCLI-509 final summary with one carrying a single set of figures, via demote then complete.
3. Confirm unresolved-at-completion lists QCLI-509; agents --check and lore check exit 0.
implementationNotes: Evidence (2026-10-20, at origin/dev 5e7f5aed01e8f9d6d509a1b9b8d9822f1c364fdb). Fresh figures: test/qcli509-release-binary-probe.test.ts 9 tests, 9 pass, 0 fail; full suite (QUEST_AGENT_PLUGINS=off bun test) 1265 pass, 1 fail across 143 files, the failure being the QCLI-411 pinned-runtime check (local bun 1.3.14, repo pin 1.4.2). The count of the full suite includes work landed after QCLI-509, which the new final summary says. Route: unresolvedAtCompletion is computed by tasks.complete(), so QCLI-509 was demoted to In Progress and completed again with the corrected final summary in one command; a field-by-field diff of the completed record against HEAD shows only finalSummary, unresolvedAtCompletion and updatedAt changed. quest task list --unresolved-at-completion --json lists QCLI-509 (6 records total, 1 match by id). quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude exit 0; lore check exit 0 (read locally after the edit). The superseded 7/1215/1216 figures and the (suite 8) mention are gone; the reviewer 1217 figure was left out so exactly one set remains.
finalSummary: QCLI-509 completed record corrected through quest commands, tracker text only. Its finalSummary now carries one set of test figures from a fresh run at origin/dev 5e7f5aed (probe suite 9 pass, full suite 1265 pass and 1 fail, the QCLI-411 local-pin check), with the superseded counts removed; QCLI-509 now persists unresolvedAtCompletion for its unchecked AC2 and is listed by quest task list --unresolved-at-completion. quest agents --check and lore check both exit 0. No code, gate or workflow change.
